response.sql: WITH status_counts AS (SELECT archstat AS status, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM scanqc GROUP BY archstat), status_shares AS (SELECT status, record_count, 1.0 * record_count / SUM(record_count) OVER () AS share FROM status_counts) SELECT status, record_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS above_average FROM status_shares WHERE share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM status_shares);
